## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. For a new play: the scheme, the play, and the idea it teaches. -->

## Kind of change

- [ ] Data: new or edited records in `data/`
- [ ] Play spec in `specs/`
- [ ] Site, tools or tests
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] No `TODO:` is left, and files are canonically formatted (`bun run data:format`)
- [ ] Anything not `illustrative` lists its sources, and the sources say what the record says
- [ ] A new play relates to at least one other play in its scheme
- [ ] I wrote this or have the right to share it, and I am fine with CC BY 4.0 for data and MIT for code
- [ ] I did not add player tracking data, film stills or copied diagrams
